title: The Temporal Ravine Where Feet Become Stone

features.name: the standing worn
features.desc-on-touch: Children's footprints have worn this stone smooth over long years. Their feet are gone. The stone remembers the exact shape of their weight.

features.name: the layered wall
features.desc-on-touch: Each stripe of stone marks a generation of use. Anthropology written in colour and time.

features.name: the whisper of names
features.desc-on-touch: Carved into the rock: initials, dates, the small claims of people on passing time. The canyon still remembers them.

reverie.title: REVERIE — the canyon path at afternoon
narr: The ravine is only visible from inside it. You walk
through where small feet have worn the stone. She walks
ahead, counting the layers the erosion made readable.
'They came here for generations,' she says. 'Look, the path
deepens.' Time is written in the canyon's walls. You are
walking through decades compressed into walking distance.

inscription: when small things repeat, they carve the world; when the world carves back, they become sacred

file.name: Children_Surgery_Case_Files_Anonymised.txt
file.note: Repeated procedures across generations: congenital corrections, rituals of healing that ancestor and child both undergo. The curve in the stone matches the curve in the scar.

exits.label: back up to the canyon that taught you time
deeper into stone where time runs differently
east where the ravine opens into wide water
